caption: The drawing features a top-down map view in the lower part and an inset landscape view in the upper left corner. The main section shows a rectangular plot dominated by green fields, marked by neatly lined rows indicating grass or crops, with groups of small, round green trees scattered throughout the area. In the center is a building with a purple roof and rectangular layout, including architectural elements such as steps and pathways leading to and from the entrances. Surrounding the building are various geometric garden plots filled with different colors indicating flowers or vegetation: areas of red, yellow, blue, and white patchwork, as well as more linear green garden beds. The property is organized by tan pathways running through the green grounds, branching out from the central building in several directions. In one area, a yellow snaking plot or flowerbed can be seen, while other sections include neat rows of small rectangles suggesting vegetable or flower beds. At the top left of the main section, a small purple-roofed structure can be found, along with another smaller outbuilding at the edge. The inset in the upper left presents a lush landscape with multiple green trees and a large building, colored in tan and purple, situated among other smaller structures and green spaces, observed from an elevated viewpoint behind a cluster of tall tree trunks. The primary colors in the drawing are various shades of green, with paths and buildings in tan, purple, and several spots of vivid red, yellow, and white for flowers or garden elements.
title: Isaac Dyckman House
